## Gap ID
API-001

## Source
gap-analysis-api-interface

## Description
OSimFlow has no variable management API. Variables are fully static in `variables.yml` with no runtime CRUD operations. Users cannot:
- Add/remove variables after campaign creation
- Modify variable distributions
- Query variable metadata

openstudio-server provides full CRUD for variables via its API.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/api/` — no variable endpoints
- `variables.yml` is the only input format
- No runtime variable modification

## Severity
Major

## Recommended Mitigation
Add a `/api/v1/variables` router with CRUD endpoints. Support runtime variable modification with proper cache invalidation.

## Labels
gap-analysis, api, variables, major
